signatures.description: A large Go CLI HTML renderer passed every enumerated end-to-end acceptance criterion but GitReins Tier 2 correctly returned INCOMPLETE because the implementation omitted four normative requirements outside the numbered AC probes: status/priority composition never rendered or recomputed on fixture toggle; the expanded-event UI bypassed the specified JSON-string/base64 detail decoding ladder; zero streaks rendered 0d instead of 0 (no activity); and wholly unparseable required JSONL was treated as an empty board warning rather than an error-state card excluded from compare. Root cause: tests optimized for the explicit 10-item AC list but did not build a requirement-to-test matrix for the full normative UX section. Fix: add each omitted UI/data path and focused regressions, then rerun full Go gates, live file:// browser probes, and the same Tier-2 judge. Verification: build/vet/tests/guard passed; live report counts and board hashes matched; GitReins verdict changed from FAIL in 1249e112 to PASS in b1a3e017; GitHub Actions green.
